multiplechoiceresponse.p: A SIEM's main job is to:

choice.div: Collect and correlate logs to surface suspicious activity.

div.p: A SIEM aggregates events from many sources and correlates them into alerts worth a human's attention.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: A spike of failed logins against many accounts from one source is most likely:

div.p: Many failures against many accounts from a single source is the classic brute-force or stuffing signature; report it and consider blocking the source.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which SOC metric best reflects responsiveness?

choice.div: The total number of alerts generated.
The number of staff on shift.

div.p: Alerts are inputs, not outcomes. How fast real incidents are detected and answered is what matters.
